body.summary: Delete the limit and preview limits of doc-mention, the maxSources parameter of doc.decision.trace and doc.constraint.enumerate (in explore/executor.ts and the two lookups) and the result cut in src/analyze/docs-retrieval.ts, so the document lookups return every section they found.

No limited entry appears for sections read or previews
